hook_text: What do a starfish, a Ndebele wall and a car wheel have in common? The same three moves.
clip_script: Mpumalanga class trip! A beehive: hexagons, no gaps. A starfish: five lines of symmetry, and a fifth of a turn looks the same. Then the Ndebele village. Bold lines, rectangles, triangles. Fold the doorway design: the halves match! The border slides along the wall: translation. On the bus home: brick walls slide, wheels turn, logos flip. Shapes, moves, symmetry. Maths is everywhere!
visual_style: Real-world montage of nature, Ndebele art and city scenes, with mirror lines, slide arrows and turn arcs drawn over them.
mood: Proud and wonder-filled, like a travel documentary.
pacing: Gentle nature shots, vibrant art reveal, then quick city cuts.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and describe a pattern in your own home.
